jobs.title: Senior Industrial Security Manager, SCI/SAP & DoD Programs
jobs.description:
The Boeing Company in San Antonio, TX seeks an experienced Industrial Security Manager to lead the execution of classified security programs at DoD Collateral, SCI and SAP levels. Candidates should have 5+ years in Industrial Security, 5+ years in security administration and team leadership, and the ability to obtain SCI/SAP access with up to 10% travel.
